# GateHouse Systems

> IT support and systems administration for small and growing businesses.
> Microsoft 365, Azure, Intune device management, helpdesk support and networking.
> Based in Ireland.

## Services

- **Microsoft 365 administration**: Tenant setup and migration, Exchange Online, SharePoint and Teams, licensing reviews, security baselines, MFA and conditional access.
- **Azure and cloud support**: Virtual machines, backup and recovery, identity with Entra ID, cost tuning and architecture for small and mid-size workloads.
- **Device management and Intune**: Zero-touch enrolment with Autopilot, compliance and configuration policies, app deployment, patching and remote wipe for Windows, macOS and mobile.
- **Helpdesk and IT support**: First- to third-line support covering accounts, access, hardware and software.
- **Network setup and troubleshooting**: Firewalls, switching, structured Wi-Fi, VPN and remote access: designed, installed and documented.
- **Security and ongoing maintenance**: Backup verification, endpoint protection, patch cycles, onboarding and offboarding, and documentation kept current.

- Engagements range from one-off projects to ongoing managed support.
